title: POST /api/v1/feed/sessions request
description: A machine's whole list of sessions now, replacing what was stored for it: a session left out is gone. Sent when the list changes and every minute meanwhile, so a machine that stops sending is known to be away. `at` is the machine's clock (Unix ms); `capabilities` says what else the machine handles.

capabilities.description: What the machine's Rakumux handles beyond the first version of this contract, so the cloud sends it only what it can use; absent from older machines (none). Known: `reply_attachments`, it fetches a reply's attachments and gives the agent their paths; `resources`, it sends what it uses (`resources-upload`) while rakumux.com asks, for rtop; `new_sessions`, it reads the new sessions asked of it on rakumux.com and starts or refuses them (the replies read's `new_sessions`); `new_session_agents`, beside `new_sessions`, it also starts `copilot`, `cursor-agent`, `pi`, `grok`, `kimi`, `droid` and `amp` in them (one with `new_sessions` alone starts `claude-code`, `codex` and `opencode`, and the cloud asks it for no other); `question_answers`, it gives answers written on rakumux.com to the questions Claude Code asks in its own dialog (`questionAnswer` in common); `question_answers.copilot`, `question_answers.droid`, `question_answers.opencode`, `question_answers.grok` and `question_answers.kimi`, beside `question_answers`, to those GitHub Copilot, Droid, OpenCode, Grok Build and Kimi Code ask too (the cloud takes an answer to an agent's question only for a machine that says so for that agent; Rakumux 0.1.39 says `question_answers` alone and gets none to Copilot's or Droid's); `remote_update`, it installs the release asked of it on rakumux.com (the replies read's `updates`), restarts its server and services in place, and reports how that went (`update-status`); `delete_sessions`, it deletes the sessions asked of it on rakumux.com that it lists (the replies read's `session_deletions`), and reports them (`session-deletion-status`). `rename_sessions`, it renames the sessions asked of it on rakumux.com that it lists (the replies read's `session_renames`), and reports them (`session-rename-status`). `choice_answers`, it lists the prompt with numbered options a session's agent shows (`sessionState` `choice`, to a cloud that takes it) and picks the option a session message names (`choiceAnswer`) while the prompt shows. The cloud keeps the latest list with the machine's sessions and ignores names it doesn't know.

rakumux_version.description: The machine's Rakumux version (its account service's), so rakumux.com can tell whether a newer release is out for it; absent from older machines and from a development build.
